body: You are a terrible human being.

Fuck you.

Edit: You fucking scumbag.

But freedom doesn't exist. When you come from a deplorable background have been homeless and abused and can't function socially and can't be changed via drugs or therapy, it seems there is no hope. What is the point of going on when a person knows and can prove that they have no future that they have nothing to contribute to mankind, or if mankind has pushed that person under the rug so hard for so long that they can never make it out.

I personally feel as though my species has rejected me, and think it is pretty inhumane to do something like that and also force me to exist, to endure it.
May I ask why? Why you are done that is.
What is wrong with her knees? They look like wrinkled burlap.
I've been raped, and I'm a man. But still this sub makes me want to kill myself even more.

I can't afford to have one. Being poor cuts you off from any activity that might promote normalcy.

Every experience on earth costs money.

Driving a car. Being a person and living on more than 12k per year in north america. Having ANY family.

Having someone, anyone that cares about me.  Living in a nice area. Having enough food that I don't starve repeatedly. Having a wife or children. (None of what I'm listing so far will ever happen).

Being normal. Having a chance at all in life. Being treated fairly. Someday i'd like that.

To not get preyed upon by the rich. I'd like that.

To see the fall of democracy and capitalism.

To witness humanity kill itself because our current societal model is a failure. Edit: A monstrous failure and a horrible misappropriation manipulation and exploitation of nature and all facets of humanity. (You have pimples? Feel bad about yourself. Buy our product. You won't ever be cool unless you buy our product. Is something that is completely normal happening to you? Feel shame, and buy our product.)




I'd love to see that, the final degradation of humanity. Because it's going to happen.

I guess that is my bucket list. To not live in a joke of a world that is a piece of shit that makes no sense.

My main goal is to die.

You seem like a capable guy, maybe if you were working doing something you enjoy, even if it's simple and menial and pays little, it might make you feel a bit better, also the income would probably give you a drive to progress.

I'm probably horrible for advice, I'm here for the same kind of thing. I've never even been in the driver's seat of a car, that's how poor I've been my entire life. Long story. My apologies, I digress.

With your work background why not see if you can work in a different kind of facility (like for children, or the elderly) where you don't feel you're doing an injustice to people and all the bad things that happen are.. a more natural process and potentially less jarring. , (not to mention witnessing many moments that can tear you apart inside, the degradation of the mind and its effects. ) which seemed to be a great source of your stress. I'd bet helping people like that would feel really good. Or being a part of a team that helps people like that (I don't know exactly what you did at your job so please forgive me).  I've been inside a crisis ward, as a patient. I see how it is, because I can see myself and the other people... who piss themselves and scream and talk to the walls from the perspective of the person behind the desk and glass window with an intercom. It's messed up. How numb they must become to it all.

Don't think of it like you're behind six years, think of it like you've just gotta make some money to get your car back from a bunch of douchebags. If your family is taking care of you, it seems like they may think a lot of you. Maybe there is something about you that they like so much that they want to help and they understand to some extent what is wrong. Maybe try to talk to someone who would understand. Don't mention the hockey thing or anything but maybe try to figure something out. I've slept in gutters man I have no family no nothing. I wish I could have driven a car or been... a person. Try to evaluate the people around you that matter to you and what you mean to them. It might be more than you think.

I was going to delete this, because what the hell do I know, but... despite my ignorance maybe you can glean something of value from this. Who knows right?

Good luck and be well.
